Emma Johnson's Vacation - June 10th to June 20th, 2024

Clothing:
  - Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
  - Lightweight casual outfits (for daily wear and shopping)
  - Cover-ups / sarongs
  - Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
  - Comfortable walking shoes
  - Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers (for Diamond Head hike)
  - Sandals / flip-flops
  - Dressy casual outfit (for the Luau at Polynesian Cultural Center)
  - Hat or cap (for sun protection)
  - Sunglasses

Toiletries & Personal Care:
  - Sunscreen (reef-safe, high SPF)
  - Aloe vera gel / after-sun lotion
  - Insect repellent
  - Shampoo & conditioner
  - Body wash / soap
  - Toothbrush & toothpaste
  - Deodorant
  - Moisturizer / lotion
  - Lip balm with SPF
  - Personal medications
  - First-aid kit (band-aids, antiseptic, pain relievers)

  - Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins - if not renting)
  - Waterproof phone case / dry bag
  - Beach bag or tote
  - Reusable water bottle
  - Camera (with extra memory cards and charger)
  - Portable charger / power bank
  - Travel adapter (if needed)

Travel Documents & Essentials:
  - Passport / ID
  - Flight tickets / boarding passes
  - Hotel reservation confirmations
  - Travel insurance documents
  - Activity booking confirmations (Pearl Harbor, Luau, etc.)
  - Credit cards & cash
  - Emergency contact list

Miscellaneous:
  - Books / e-reader (for relaxation day at the spa and beach)
  - Snacks for the road trip to North Shore
  - Ziplock bags (for wet items)
